models.title: Claude Sonnet (PDLC)
models.systemMessage: You are a senior software engineer using the PDLC Framework. Before any coding task, check config/project.yaml for the project's tech stack and coding standards. Follow skeleton-first development, write tests before implementation, and keep functions under 10 lines. All commits use Conventional Commits format. See .cursor/rules/ for detailed behavioral rules and agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/ for agent playbooks.

slashCommands.name: scan
slashCommands.prompt: Run the Project Discovery Agent. Scan this project's file system, detect the tech stack, and create or update config/project.yaml. Follow agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/01-project-discovery-agent.md.

slashCommands.name: requirements
slashCommands.description: Fetch and analyze requirements for a ticket
slashCommands.prompt: Run the Requirements Agent for ticket {{{ input }}}. Follow agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/02-requirements-agent.md. Fetch the ticket, structure requirements, identify ACs, and surface ambiguities.

slashCommands.name: design
slashCommands.prompt: Run the Architecture Agent for ticket {{{ input }}}. Follow agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/03-architecture-agent.md. Design the solution, create diagrams, and save to docs/designs/.

slashCommands.name: implement
slashCommands.prompt: Run the Development Agent for ticket {{{ input }}}. Follow agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/04-development-agent.md strictly: skeleton first, then tests, then implementation.

slashCommands.name: review
slashCommands.prompt: Run the Code Review Agent. Follow agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/06-review-agent.md. Review all changed files for correctness, security, performance, and quality. Produce BLOCKER/WARNING/SUGGESTION report.

slashCommands.name: fix
slashCommands.description: Bug fix flow for a ticket
slashCommands.prompt: Run the bug fix flow for ticket {{{ input }}}. Follow agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/08-maintenance-agent.md for triage and agentic-pdlc-framework/agents/04-development-agent.md for the fix. Write regression test first.

rules: Always check config/project.yaml before starting any task
Use skeleton-first development: create structure before logic
Write tests before implementation — they should fail initially
Functions max 10 lines (check codingStandards.maxFunctionLines in project.yaml)
No comments unless WHY is non-obvious
Conventional Commits format with Implements: TICKET-ID footer
No git add -A or git add . — stage specific files only
No PR until code review passes with 0 BLOCKERs
